name: Alessara
summary: Alessara is wrapped entirely in richly textured fabric, giving it a seamless and sculptural presence. The continuous upholstery softens its silhouette, while the tailored detailing reveals a refined attention to craft. With an air of quiet grace and timeless character, it brings warmth and distinction to modern living spaces. 60x54x78
